title: Researcher-in-the-Loop Evolutionary Discovery of Entanglement-Assisted Quantum Code Families
abstract: arXiv:2610.41183v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-guided program evolution can produce mathematical constructions, but validity, generality, and reproducibility require distinct evidence. We develop a researcher-in-the-loop discovery pipeline that combines program evolution, exact evaluation, mathematical generalization, certified nonexistence checks, and formal proof checking. We apply it to entanglement-assisted quantum error-correcting codes (EAQECCs). Starting from tasks that did not specify a family formula, evolved programs produced finite qubit constructions whose structure researchers generalized to the family $[[n,1,n-1;n-q-1]]_q$ for prime powers $q\ge3$ at $n\ge2q+1$ and for $q=2$ at odd $n\ge5$. Lean checks the algebraic certificate underlying this family. Together with entanglement lifting, the family closes 54 gaps in archived EAQECC tables. translated_title: 研究者在环的纠缠辅助量子码族演化发现
translated_abstract: 由大语言模型（LLM）引导的程序演化能够产生数学构造，但其有效性、普遍性与可复现性需要独立的证据支持。我们开发了一条研究者在环（researcher-in-the-loop）的发现流程，将程序演化、精确评估、数学推广、经认证的不存在性检验以及形式化证明检查结合在一起，并将其应用于纠缠辅助量子纠错码（EAQECC）。从并未指定码族公式的任务出发，演化出的程序产生了一些有限的量子比特构造，研究者将其结构推广为码族 $[[n,1,n-1;n-q-1]]_q$，该码族适用于素数幂 $q\ge3$ 且 $n\ge2q+1$ 的情形，以及 $q=2$ 且 $n\ge5$ 为奇数的情形。Lean 验证了支撑该码族的代数证书。结合纠缠提升（entanglement lifting）技术，该码族填补了已存档 EAQECC 表格中的 54 个空白。所发布的证据包括 115 条经过验证的码记录、十项附有已检验 DRAT 证明的不存在性结果，以及码族的实现（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种“研究者在环”的发现流程，将 LLM 引导的程序演化、精确评估与形式化证明检查相结合，发现并严格验证了新的纠缠辅助量子纠错码族 $[[n,1,n-1;n-q-1]]_q$，填补了现有表格中的 54 个空白。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a researcher-in-the-loop discovery pipeline combining LLM-guided program evolution, exact evaluation, and formal proof checking, which discovers and rigorously certifies a new family of entanglement-assisted quantum error-correcting codes $[[n,1,n-1;n-q-1]]_q$, closing 54 gaps in archived EAQECC tables.
